# Healthcare Governance

This folder groups the governing bodies and quality-improvement teams that oversee and drive clinical standards in Danish acute surgery. It contains the steering committee (Styregruppen) responsible for governing the acute surgery database, evaluating clinical indicators, and making decisions on national monitoring and medical coding. Additionally, it includes the Learning and Quality Teams (LKT and LKT Akutkirurgi), which have historically led national initiatives to improve specific surgical processes, such as timely CT scanning and antibiotic administration, before concluding their active phases.

## Pages

- [[lkt-akut-kirurgi|LKT Akutkirurgi]] — The Learning and Quality Team for acute surgery, which drove national improvements in indicators such as timely CT scanning and antibiotic documentation before concluding in 2022.
- [[lkt|LKT]] — The broader Learning and Quality Team entity, noted for supporting the registration of specific clinical indicators and improving data registration practices.
- [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] — The steering committee for the acute surgery database, comprising multidisciplinary members who govern the database, revise indicator populations, and make decisions on clinical monitoring and coding.
